rows.en:
(Pool class on a day this hot
is gonna be the best.
I'll hurry up, get ready and jump in.)

Yo, Fresh Boy.
Where are you off to in such a hurry?

Oh, Luis-san.
I've got pool class now, so...

Wait, what are you wearing!?
Luis-san!

What do you mean, 'what am I wearing',
Fresh Boy?

It's crazy hot today, y'know.
I'm just wearing a swimsuit, that's all.

(A swimsuit in the school hallway
is kind of pushing it, though...)

Oh, right, you're in a hurry.
Sorry for stopping you.
N-No problem...
See you around, Fresh Boy.

(Luis-san...
this time you really could get arrested...)

(Pool class on a day this hot
is gonna be the best.
I'll hurry up, get ready and jump in.)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
Where are you off to in such a hurry?

What do you mean, 'what am I wearing',
Fresh Girl?
See you around, Fresh Girl.
(Let's see, my next class is...)
(Huh? Is that... Luis-san in the schoolyard?)
(Is he... singing or something?)

(Oh, Hilda-sensei showed up,
and she's chewing Luis-san out...)
(And he ran for it!)

(Hmm......
What was Luis-san even trying to do...?)
(Is he... singing or something?)
(And he ran for it!)

(Hmm......
What was Luis-san even trying to do...?)

(I shouldn't have asked so casually
just because I was bored at lunch break...)

So Basara Nekki is a man I respect,
and my eternal rival too.
That's what it comes down to...

(All I asked was 'Do you like Fire Bomber?'
I never thought Luis-san would start
going on about it this passionately...)
rows.notes: Japanese writes FIRE BOMBER in full-width capitals; glossary spelling 'Fire Bomber' used.

rows.en:
So, like...
Hey, are you even listening, Fresh Boy!?
Ah, yes!
Oh, sorry...

...Geez, what's gotten into me...
Anybody'd be thrown off with some guy
raving at 'em this hard, huh.
No, not at all...

You don't need words to talk about Basara Nekki.
What you need is a song with soul in it...

All right! Listen to my song...
'Totsugeki Love Heart'.

(Ahh... Luis-san's started singing...
At this rate, lunch break's gonna be over...)

(I shouldn't have asked so casually
just because I was bored at lunch break...)

So, like...
Hey, are you even listening, Fresh Girl!?

(Ahh... Luis-san's started singing...
At this rate, lunch break's gonna be over...)

(Classes are over,
so I guess I'll head home...)
Luis-san, what are you doing here?

Yo, Fresh Boy.
Heard a rumor some creep's been lurking
around school lately, so I'm doin' a patrol.
O-Oh, is that so...?

If I find this creep, I'll tie 'em up good!
You can relax and leave it all to me!!
G-Good luck with that...
You bet! Well, I'm off on patrol.

(Um...
The creep isn't Luis-san himself,
is it?)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
Heard a rumor some creep's been lurking
around school lately, so I'm doin' a patrol.

(Um...
The creep isn't Luis-san himself,
is it?)

(Hmm, I just can't solve this problem...
It's already evening, too.
I've gotta figure it out somehow...)

Oh, Fresh Boy.
Studying of your own free will?
You're a regular bookworm, ain'tcha?

Oh, Luis-san.
Actually, this one problem is the only one
I can't solve, so I was stuck on it...

Hooh, this problem, huh?
This one goes...

Luis-san...
If you don't know either, I'll just give up, so...

Give up!?
God himself could allow it, and Luis still wouldn't!
Just a bit more... A bit more and I'll crack it...!
(I-I'm not so sure about that...)
Since this part works out like this...

(I guess I can't go home either
until Luis-san finishes solving it...)

(Hmm, I just can't solve this problem...
It's already evening, too.
I've gotta figure it out somehow...)

Oh, Fresh Girl.
Studying of your own free will?
You're a regular bookworm maiden, ain'tcha?

Luis-san...
If you don't know either, I'll just give up, so...

(I guess I can't go home either
until Luis-san finishes solving it...)

uncertain: c17594/c17602: 'If you don't know either' - read as the player offering to give up so Luis can stop struggling with it; Luis's reply 'Give up!?' fits.
c17595: 'kono Luis ga mitomenee' rendered with Luis naming himself in the third person ('Luis still wouldn't').
